name: Enlightened Vindicator (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
An inquisitor can choose to walk the path of martial tactics, or the path of inspired magic. Those choosing the latter can learn deeper secrets of divine power to directly destroy their enemies.

Spell Combatant (Ex)

The enlightened vindicator has learned to cast spells in combat more easily. At 3rd level, she can provide somatic components for inquisitor spells while holding items, wielding weapons, or carrying a shield. They still must be able to move normally.

This replaces solo tactics.

Holy Power (Ex)

At 3rd level, the enlightened vindicator increases the effective level of her spells. All effects dependent on spell level (such as saving throw DCs and ability to penetrate a lesser globe of invulnerability) are calculated as if the spell were 1 level higher. Caster level is not affected.

At 9th level, effects are calculated as if the spell were 2 levels higher. At 15th level, effects are calculated as if they were 3 levels higher.

This replaces the teamwork feats gained at 3rd, 9th, and 15th level.

Tactical Spellcasting (Ex)

At 6th level, the enlightened vindicator can improvise with her spellcasting. Once per day, she may cast a spell from her spell list even if it is not one of her known spells. This consumes a spell slot normally, and can be affected by metamagic normally. She may do this twice per day at 12th level, and 3 times per day at 18th level.

This replaces the teamwork feats gained at 6th, 12th, and 18th level.
